headline: COMFORT
IS A
SUBSCRIPTION.

scenes.say: Your safe job might be the most expensive decision you ever made.
Comfort never sends a bill. Its price is the road you didn't take.
Same starting pay. One stays put, raises of {safe_rate}. One keeps learning and moving, {grow_rate}.
scenes.note: Assumption: income grows {safe_rate} vs {grow_rate} a year

scenes.say: {years} years later, one earns {gap_ratio} times the other.
Staying still isn't risk-free. It's the risk of being left behind, delivered slowly.
Comfort is a subscription. You just never see the invoice.

takeaway: Comfort is a subscription. You just never see the invoice.
